report.summary: All four failures are one flaky cause, not four separate bugs. The app's /books page handler sleeps for a random 0-8 seconds on each render, and the UI tests give page actions a 5-second timeout, so the page sometimes loads too slowly. Fix the random delay in app/main.py (remove it, or make it deterministic in test runs), then rerun the UI suite.

causes.title: list_books() sleeps a random 0-8 s, so /books sometimes exceeds the 5 s UI timeout
causes.explanation: list_books() in app/main.py calls time.sleep(random.uniform(0, 8)) before querying the database. Every /books page render goes through list_books via render_books (app/main.py:256) and books_page (app/main.py:311-314). The UI conftest sets a 5000 ms default timeout (tests/ui/conftest.py:7). When the random delay is over about 5 s, Page.goto('/books') times out. Roughly 3 in 8 renders should exceed the limit, so the same code passes on some reruns and fails on others. The register test fails the same way: after a successful POST /register, the browser follows the redirect to /books, that render hits the same delay, and the click's 'waiting for scheduled navigations to finish' step times out. All four failures happen at or before the first /books load, before any assertion about behaviour, so they say nothing about the behaviour under test. The app is only sometimes slow, so per triage rules this is flaky, not a product_bug. The underlying cause is the random sleep in the app code.
evidence: tests.ui.test_books_ui::test_deleted_book_disappears: 'Page.goto: Timeout 5000ms exceeded.' navigating to http://127.0.0.1:63002/books, waiting until "load" (tests\support\pages.py:34)

tests.ui.test_login_ui::test_new_user_lands_on_empty_bookshelf: 'Locator.click: Timeout 5000ms exceeded.' ... 'waiting for scheduled navigations to finish' after clicking data-testid=submit on /register (tests\ui\test_login_ui.py:9)
app/main.py:149-150: def list_books(user_id: int) -> list[dict]: / time.sleep(random.uniform(0, 8))
app/main.py:250-261: render_books() calls list_books(user["id"]) on every /books render
tests/ui/conftest.py:4-7: autouse fail_fast fixture sets page.set_default_timeout(5000)
tests/support/pages.py:33-35: BooksPage.open() calls self.page.goto("/books") with no retry
causes.suggested_fix: Remove the time.sleep(random.uniform(0, 8)) from list_books() in app/main.py:150. If the delay is needed to model slowness, make it a fixed, configurable value that is off by default in tests (e.g. an env var), so the UI tests are not at the mercy of a random sleep. As a secondary measure, the 5 s timeout is tight for a page load and could be raised for navigation only. Then rerun tests/ui several times to confirm the four tests pass consistently. The truncated part of app/main.py (after line 317) was not read, but none of the four failures reach code past the initial /books load, so it is not implicated.
